_original_lore: The Flare Demon is a Inferno Demonlord
Miniboss that very rarely spawns after killing a
Blaze during Inferno Demonlord Tier III Quests.
name: 耀斑恶魔 (小首领)

source: The Flare Demon is a Inferno Demonlord
Miniboss that very rarely spawns after killing a
Blaze during Inferno Demonlord Tier III Quests.
loreParagraphs.translation: 耀斑恶魔是炼狱恶魔领主小首领,在炼狱恶魔领主 III 阶任务中击杀烈焰人有极低概率生成.
